# CodeCombat中国

> Game-based programming education platform combining AI technology, youth coding competitions, and interactive learning for students worldwide.

CodeCombat (扣哒世界) is an educational technology platform that uses game mechanics to teach programming to students. The platform emphasizes game-based learning, open-source community participation, and global reach through initiatives like the AI World Youth Competition (AI世青赛).

## Key Topics

- Game-based learning
- Programming education
- AI World Youth Competition
- Youth coding
- Educational platform
- Open-source community
- Student data protection
- GDPR compliance
- Interactive learning
- Global reach
- Data privacy
- Terms of service
- Company mission
- Team members
- Legal compliance
